items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I used to get him over there and I'd breathe him well, you know.

ctx.x: You said everybody, when Lewis played the blues, everybody really liked that.

Mm-hmm. You see Lewis, you're talking about Lewis Armstrong? Yeah. He used to play piano too. He did? He's a good piano player. Yeah, because he used to go to my watch. We used to get him to play on Saturday nights and have fish fry and put the lantern out and, you see, it'd be all along in downtown there on Saratoga, and Gravy. Well, the one in the biggest crowd would have music where they'd come. All of them? The people would fly there, you know. Oh yeah. So I had an old piano sitting in the dining room in them…
